Modes and setup

Everything is entered through the calculator. MODE opens the LCD mode menu; press 1–8 to select a mode. In multi-field screens, enter a value, press = to advance, and AC to exit. SHIFT → MODE opens LCD setup.

Press MODE, then the corresponding numbered key (1–8). SHIFT + MODE opens SETUP. AC exits. Use only calculator buttons for calculations.

CASIO emulator keyboard shortcuts: F1 = SHIFT, F2 = ALPHA, F3 or Home = MODE, F4 = ON; Enter = equals, Backspace/Delete = DEL, arrows = REPLAY, Space = AC, and digits/operators type normally. Tab and Shift+Tab navigate normally. With the calculator case focused, Space = AC and Ctrl+Z undoes the last MathIO edit. In MathIO, SHIFT + DEL activates one-shot function incorporation; in LineIO it changes insert/overwrite mode. Browser controls keep standard keyboard navigation. Ctrl+C or Ctrl+Insert copies the LCD when clipboard permissions allow it.

CASIO compatibility — feature status

Implemented means available in this web application, not verified against a physical CASIO calculator. Approximation means partial educational functionality. Hardware verification requires native reference evidence.
